meta.parties: Emanis Singho v. Inspector of Police, Dompe

rules.statement: The charge of criminal trespass must include an averment that the property was in the occupation of another person.
rules.supporting_quote: "The charge of criminal trespass can be committed by a person only in respect of property in the occupation (not merely possession) of another. The charge of criminal trespass would itself be defective if it contains no averment that the property was in the occupation of a person."
